entities.summary: The 17th of Ramadan Mosque is a mosque in al-Rusafa, Baghdad, in the Baghdad Governorate of Iraq. The mosque is situated in the eastern Karrada district, opposite al-Firdos Square, in front of the Ishtar Hotel. The mosque dates from the royal era of Iraq and is considered an important historical landmark since it is located in a significant square in the city.
